Station Medic

A quiet infirmary on a worn space station. Read the signs, choose the scans, share a thin cabinet. Nothing is timed, and a bad call only costs a seal. A fiction game, not medical advice.

Shifts

A chapter opens once five shifts of the one before are done. Inside a chapter, take any shift in any order. The seal on a shift is the best you have earned there.

Achievements

Every one can be earned in any order, with no luck and no deadline, and each shows how close you are.
